summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Days-of-cover for fuel, food and medicine are defined (usable stock or capacity divided by average daily consumption of the same product and period, with capacity-based and actual-stock-based cover kept separate). Leads located for petroleum: NOC publications, import/sales pages and notices, the MoF Economic Survey, and news items that point to the Lothar (Chitwan) depot and Amlekhgunj-Lothar pipeline extension and to 2026 fuel-supply measures during the Middle East disruption. No primary leads were located for food reserves (FMTCL/National Food Reserve) or medicine buffer stocks; these are pending with the exact data required. No values retrieved.

findings.claim: Q1a: Petroleum stock cover - days of consumption covered by NOC storage capacity and by actual stocks, by product (petrol, diesel, kerosene, ATF, LPG).
findings.note: Requires NOC depot capacity (kl, t) by product and average daily sales (Nepal FY); capacity-based and actual-stock-based cover are distinct measures. Leads 19E-L01..L04.

findings.claim: Q1b: Food stock cover - days of national cereal requirement covered by Food Management and Trading Company / National Food Reserve stocks.
findings.note: Requires food reserve stock (t) and consumption; no FMTCL or MoALD lead located in r1 (search budget exhausted); catalog lacks FMTCL.

findings.claim: Q1c: Medicine stock cover - buffer stock of essential medicines (Department of Health Services Logistics Management Section / Management Division) in months or days.
findings.note: Requires DoHS logistics stock reports; no lead located in r1.

findings.claim: Q1d: 2026 petroleum supply measures during the Middle East disruption (tax cuts on fuel, demand management, price revisions) - verify from Cabinet/NOC/MoF primary documents.
Days of cover = usable stock (or capacity) / average daily sales of the same product and period; tank capacity is not stock, and both are reported separately.
Resilience analysis covers lawful civilian preparedness only (essential-service continuity, stock policy); no security-sensitive facility detail is recorded.

data_gaps: Food Management and Trading Company / national food reserve stock data - not in catalog, no lead.
DoHS essential-medicine buffer stock reports - no lead.
NOC depot-level capacity by product in a dated primary file not yet located.
2026 Cabinet decisions on fuel taxes and demand measures - primary documents not located.

WebSearch budget for the session was exhausted during r1 before all lead searches were completed; leads marked 'NOT confirmed by web search' use catalog base URLs or known primary domains and must be verified on fetch.

assumptions.text: Capacity-based and actual-stock-based days of cover are distinct measures and never substituted for each other.

challenges.text: Fuel price shocks in S01 should be paired with a supply-quantity constraint when days-of-cover is short; request joint treatment.
X29 essential imports: food and medicine stock data are missing; propose FMTCL and DoHS as sources (with 00A).
Add FMTCL, MoALD and DoHS Management Division to the source catalog.
SPOF-01 'days of storage cover' measure is supplied by 19E; the Lothar depot and pipeline extension are pending projects that should be noted as capacity changes with dates.

uncertainty: High. No stock or cover value retrieved; food and medicine have no located primary source. Days-of-cover varies seasonally and by product.

stock_cover_days.method: Days of cover = usable stock (or capacity) / average daily sales, same product and period; Nepal FY or monthly.
